title: Concept: Lockfile records a dependency that runs an install script
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry flagged as running an install script, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Install scripts execute with the build user's privileges before any review step, so the dependency's code runs even if the project never imports it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Install scripts execute with the build user's privileges before any review step, so the dependency's code runs even if the project never imports it.
